newsitem.title: USA: U.S. stock index futures end moderatesly higher.
newsitem.headline: U.S. stock index futures end moderatesly higher.

text.p: Sept 11 - U.S. stock index futures ended moderately higher. Traders said Sept S&P 500s staged a gradual move up, with few quick swings on Wednesday, supported by the comeback in T-bond futures. They expected futures could stay steady overnight before Thursday's PPI, seen up 0.1 pct overall and in core.
They said Dec S&Ps become lead month in the pit on Thursday.
